entries.title: Bee-to-Flower Pollen Transfer Garden
entries.description: A bee-shaped sphere flies between colorful flower models, landing on petals to collect and transfer tiny yellow pollen particles that attach, detach, and leave faint trails, while a counter label tracks successful pollinations above each plant.

entries.title: Microscopic Pollen Grain Zoom-In
entries.description: A few oversized, spiky pollen grains slowly rotate and drift in a transparent air volume, colliding with a textured, semi-transparent stigma surface where grains that touch stick, swell, and start glowing as they activate.

entries.title: Wind Pollination Field

entries.title: Pollen Tube Growth Race

entries.title: Bat Pollination at Night

entries.title: Water Surface Pollination

entries.title: Robot Pollinator Arm
